verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm SendGrid offers domain authentication that 'verifies the legitimacy of your email servers, messages, and sending addresses' (a UI-focused guide). Community reports that SendGrid makes it easy to pass SPF/DKIM when sending on behalf of clients. The pack does not show the specifics the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence that exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are generated, a documented verification step, verification status exposed via the API, DMARC coverage, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
